title: Show HN: Real-time Solar System with 526k asteroids and all tracked satellites
summary: A real-time 3D solar system simulation featuring 526,000 asteroids and all tracked satellites, built as an interactive web visualization using WebGL/Canvas rendering for educational and astronomical exploration purposes.
problem_solved: Visualizes the vast scale of our solar system with realistic asteroid counts and satellite tracking data in an accessible web browser experience.
why_valuable: Makes complex astronomical data accessible and visually engaging, helping users understand the true scale of our solar system with hundreds of thousands of objects.
